versions.changelog:
Initial release of "academic-research" skill for academic literature retrieval and structuring.

- Enables structured searches across PubMed, Springer, PLOS, etc., focusing on epidemiology, medical, and market research literature.
- Automates data extraction (prevalence, sample size, year, country), with prioritized literature types (meta-analysis > systematic review > large cohorts).
- Outputs structured reports grouped by region, including complete reference markup and PubMed links.
- Generates presentation-ready (PPT) output with inline and appendix citations.
- Applies best practices: recent 5-year focus, definition reporting, and data comparability notes.
